articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.snippet: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

articles.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
articles.snippet: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.

articles.title: Republican Senator Wants to Freeze AI Data Center Boom as Congress Pushes to Expand It
articles.snippet: Senator Josh Hawley wants a nationwide construction pause until households are protected from rising power bills, even as Congress advances legislation designed to accelerate America's already massive AI infrastructure buildout.

articles.title: Who Is Colette Kress, Jensen Huang’s Successor as Nvidia CEO?
articles.snippet: Nvidia’s longtime finance chief inherits its first leadership transition in 33 years, bringing decades of technology experience and Wall Street credibility to a company facing a very public leadership test.
